HDPMI32 (Japheth / HX DOS Extender runtime)

Source package:
  https://ibiblio.org/pub/micro/pc-stuff/freedos/files/util/system/hx-dos-extender/2.20/HXRT220.zip
  Package: HXRT220.zip (HX DOS Extender runtime v2.20)

Extracted for this experiment:
  BIN/HDPMI32.EXE  -> HDPMI32.EXE
  BIN/DPMI.EXE     -> DPMI.EXE (host identity probe)
  DOC/HDPMI.TXT    -> HDPMI.TXT

SHA-256 (HDPMI32.EXE):
  F9C1A21A0673B9E771AC0BFE09AE11E90E264882AC067E27E94DEA2AACA66415

License: HX runtime freeware (see HDPMI.TXT section 10).
Not linked into Quake; used only as an external DPMI server beside qbench.exe.
